description:
gf2-sim rare-event artifact validation rejects any design identity whose path is not `dev/active/3f664839/design.md`. It identifies the design by its recorded revision and blob identity instead of the path string.

## Background

Readers: `crates/gf2-sim/src/permanent_rare_event/artifact.rs:4245-4250` and `crates/gf2-sim/tests/permanent_rare_event_artifacts.rs:55`.

## Success Criteria

- [hard] REQ-01: Design-identity validation checks the recorded revision and blob identity and no longer compares the recorded path to a literal; the revision and blob checks are unchanged.
- [hard] REQ-02: Before the change, a linked baseline record lists the artifact-validation verdict for every committed rare-event artifact and snapshot copy, with the exact command and commit; after the change, the same run yields identical verdicts, so existing artifacts stay valid.
- [hard] REQ-03: A test validates an artifact whose design identity names a different path with the same content identity.
- [hard] REQ-04: No historical-path allow-list or hard-coded `dev/` path remains in the changed consumer; code review checks the change against `@/inv/no-dev-path-coupling`.
- [hard] REQ-05: The Rust CI gate passes.
title: Identify the rare-event design by content in gf2-sim artifact checks
